hypotheses.reasoning: auth-svc calls to the external identity provider hang for 30s and time out, starting at 09:54:12. This is before the edge-proxy 503s on POST /login, which begin at 09:56. The 503s are downstream symptoms. I did not check account-svc errors or the logs before 09:54, so this is not fully ruled out.
The identity provider could be down. The calls time out rather than fail fast, which fits a hang better.

verdict.recommendedAction: Check identity provider health. Lower the idp client timeout and add a circuit breaker or fallback in auth-svc. Escalate to the idp vendor if they are degraded.
